summary: News Corp filed an 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) on July 27, 2026, disclosing daily repurchase transaction information provided to the Australian Securities Exchange as required under ASX rules. The repurchase program authorizes the company to acquire up to $1 billion in aggregate of its Class A and Class B common stock. No specific shares purchased or prices were disclosed in the excerpt. The filing is routine periodic disclosure of ongoing buyback activity, reflecting a capital return program. The company disclaims forward-looking statements. What to watch: future quarterly/annual reports for cumulative repurchase progress against the $1 billion authorization.
